name: fast_signal
description: Day-by-day iteration eval. ~3-4h per checkpoint on 1 GPU. None of these benchmarks require GPT-4 judge — exact-match / MCQ rules or open-judge fallback are sufficient. Run this for every training checkpoint.

notes.MMBench_DEV_EN: 1164 dev-set MCQ; rule-based + cheap-LM refusal detection. No paid judge needed.
notes.MMMU_DEV_VAL: 900 reasoning MCQ from val split; rule-based.
notes.MathVista_MINI: 1000-sample math reasoning subset; mostly MCQ + numeric, rule-based with occasional LM-judge for open-ended.
